name: Behind Genius Ventures

Confirmed via behindgeniusventures.com (behindgenius.com redirects there) and Fortune's 2024-04-23 article on its second fund, founder Paige Finn Doherty. Portfolio page names Maneva, Intramotev, MoldCo. Not Genius Ventures or Genius Group.
